```{r installs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE }
library(tidyverse)
library(lhs)
library(BASS)
library(GPfit)
library(gt)
```

```{r objective-and-settings}
set.seed(1244)

# =========================
# Problem dimension
# =========================
d <- 3

# =========================
# Objective function to minimize
# Input: X is n x d (or vector length d)
# Output: numeric vector length n
#
# This is a smooth + mildly nonstationary synthetic function on [0,1]^d
# Keep this as your default, or replace with Branin/Hartmann wrappers.
# =========================
f <- function(X) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  if (is.null(nrow(X))) X <- matrix(X, nrow = 1)
  
  # Base bowl
  base <- rowSums((X - 0.35)^2)
  
  # Oscillation + interaction
  osc1 <- sin(6 * pi * X[, 1]) * exp(-2 * X[, 1])
  osc2 <- if (ncol(X) >= 2) 0.35 * cos(5 * pi * X[, 2]^2) else 0
  inter <- if (ncol(X) >= 2) 0.5 * X[, 1] * X[, 2] else 0
  
  # Local bump and local valley in d-D
  c1 <- rep(0.2, ncol(X))
  c2 <- rep(0.75, ncol(X))
  bump <- 1.2 * exp(-35 * rowSums((X - matrix(c1, nrow(X), ncol(X), byrow = TRUE))^2))
  valley <- -1.0 * exp(-28 * rowSums((X - matrix(c2, nrow(X), ncol(X), byrow = TRUE))^2))
  
  # Small discontinuity in first coordinate
  jump <- ifelse(X[, 1] > 0.62, 0.4, 0)
  
  base + osc1 + osc2 + inter + bump + valley + jump
}

# =========================
# Experiment settings
# =========================
n0 <- max(2 * d + 1, 8)   # initial design
budget <- 80              # BO iterations after initialization
n_cand <- 1000            # candidate pool size per iteration
kappa <- 2.0              # LCB exploration parameter
eps <- 1e-10              # numerical floor for GP sd
dup_tol <- 1e-10          # duplicate tolerance in Euclidean norm

# Utility: duplicate check
is_duplicate <- function(x, X, tol = 1e-10) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  xmat <- matrix(x, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = ncol(X), byrow = TRUE)
  any(rowSums((X - xmat)^2) <= tol^2)
}
```

```{r initialization}
# Shared initialization across all methods
X_init <- maximinLHS(n0, d)
y_init <- f(X_init)

init_df <- as_tibble(X_init, .name_repair = ~ paste0("x", seq_along(.))) %>%
  mutate(y = y_init)

init_df
```

```{r bass-bo-function}
run_bass_bo <- function(X_init, y_init, budget, n_cand, kappa, dup_tol = 1e-10) {
  X_eval <- as.matrix(X_init)
  y_eval <- as.numeric(y_init)
  d <- ncol(X_eval)
  
  best_so_far <- numeric(budget + 1)
  best_so_far[1] <- min(y_eval)
  
  for (t in 1:budget) {
    fit <- bass(
      xx = X_eval,
      y = y_eval,
      degree = 2,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # Candidate pool in [0,1]^d
    X_cand <- maximinLHS(n_cand, d)
    
    # Posterior predictive draws
    pred <- predict(fit, newdata = as.data.frame(X_cand))
    pred_mat <- as.matrix(pred)
    
    # Ensure rows=draws, cols=candidates
    if (ncol(pred_mat) != nrow(X_cand) && nrow(pred_mat) == nrow(X_cand)) {
      pred_mat <- t(pred_mat)
    }
    
    mu <- colMeans(pred_mat)
    sd_post <- apply(pred_mat, 2, sd)
    
    # LCB (minimization)
    lcb <- mu - kappa * sd_post
    
    # Pick best non-duplicate candidate
    ord <- order(lcb)
    pick <- NA_integer_
    for (idx in ord) {
      x_try <- X_cand[idx, ]
      if (!is_duplicate(x_try, X_eval, tol = dup_tol)) {
        pick <- idx
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.na(pick)) pick <- ord[1]
    
    x_next <- X_cand[pick, , drop = FALSE]
    y_next <- f(x_next)
    
    X_eval <- rbind(X_eval, x_next)
    y_eval <- c(y_eval, y_next)
    
    best_so_far[t + 1] <- min(y_eval)
    
    # Print out the current iteration
    cat(sprintf("Iteration %d / %d completed\n", t, budget))
  }
  
  list(
    X_eval = X_eval,
    y_eval = y_eval,
    best_so_far = best_so_far
  )
}
```

```{r gp-bo-function}
run_gp_bo <- function(X_init, y_init, budget, n_cand, kappa, eps = 1e-10, dup_tol = 1e-10) {
  X_eval <- as.matrix(X_init)
  y_eval <- as.numeric(y_init)
  d <- ncol(X_eval)
  
  best_so_far <- numeric(budget + 1)
  best_so_far[1] <- min(y_eval)
  
  for (t in 1:budget) {
    fit <- GP_fit(
      X = X_eval,
      Y = y_eval
    )
    
    # Candidate pool
    X_cand <- maximinLHS(n_cand, d)
    
    pred <- predict(
      object = fit,
      xnew = X_cand
    )
    
    mu <- as.numeric(pred$Y_hat)
    sd_gp <- sqrt(pmax(as.numeric(pred$MSE), 0) + eps)
    
    lcb <- mu - kappa * sd_gp
    
    # Pick best non-duplicate candidate
    ord <- order(lcb)
    pick <- NA_integer_
    for (idx in ord) {
      x_try <- X_cand[idx, ]
      if (!is_duplicate(x_try, X_eval, tol = dup_tol)) {
        pick <- idx
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.na(pick)) pick <- ord[1]
    
    x_next <- X_cand[pick, , drop = FALSE]
    y_next <- f(x_next)
    
    X_eval <- rbind(X_eval, x_next)
    y_eval <- c(y_eval, y_next)
    
    best_so_far[t + 1] <- min(y_eval)
    
    # Print out the current iteration
    cat(sprintf("Iteration %d / %d completed\n", t, budget))
  }
  
  list(
    X_eval = X_eval,
    y_eval = y_eval,
    best_so_far = best_so_far
  )
}
```

```{r random-search-function}
run_random_search <- function(X_init, y_init, budget, dup_tol = 1e-10) {
  X_eval <- as.matrix(X_init)
  y_eval <- as.numeric(y_init)
  d <- ncol(X_eval)
  
  best_so_far <- numeric(budget + 1)
  best_so_far[1] <- min(y_eval)
  
  for (t in 1:budget) {
    # Keep trying until non-duplicate (usually immediate in continuous space)
    repeat {
      x_next <- matrix(runif(d), nrow = 1)
      if (!is_duplicate(as.numeric(x_next), X_eval, tol = dup_tol)) break
    }
    
    y_next <- f(x_next)
    
    X_eval <- rbind(X_eval, x_next)
    y_eval <- c(y_eval, y_next)
    
    best_so_far[t + 1] <- min(y_eval)
    
    # Print out the current iteration
    cat(sprintf("Iteration %d / %d completed\n", t, budget))
  }
  
  list(
    X_eval = X_eval,
    y_eval = y_eval,
    best_so_far = best_so_far
  )
}
```

```{r run-experiment}
res_bass <- run_bass_bo(
  X_init = X_init, y_init = y_init,
  budget = budget, n_cand = n_cand,
  kappa = kappa, dup_tol = dup_tol
)

res_gp <- run_gp_bo(
  X_init = X_init, y_init = y_init,
  budget = budget, n_cand = n_cand,
  kappa = kappa, eps = eps, dup_tol = dup_tol
)

res_rand <- run_random_search(
  X_init = X_init, y_init = y_init,
  budget = budget, dup_tol = dup_tol
)
```

```{r convergence-data}
conv_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(iter = 0:budget, best = res_bass$best_so_far, method = "BASS-BO"),
  tibble(iter = 0:budget, best = res_gp$best_so_far,   method = "GP-BO"),
  tibble(iter = 0:budget, best = res_rand$best_so_far, method = "Random Search")
)

head(conv_df)
```

```{r convergence-plot}
ggplot(conv_df, aes(x = iter, y = best, color = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Convergence Comparison (d = ", d, ")"),
    x = "Iteration (after initialization)",
    y = "Best objective value found (lower is better)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r summary-table}
summary_tbl <- conv_df %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarize(
    final_best = best[which.max(iter)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(final_best)

summary_tbl
```

```{r summary-gt}
summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = paste0("Final Best Objective by Method (d = ", d, ")"))
```

```{r visualization-2-dim}
# Optional: visualize sampled locations only when d = 2
evals_bass <- as_tibble(res_bass$X_eval, .name_repair = ~ c("x1","x2")) %>%
  mutate(method = "BASS-BO")
evals_gp <- as_tibble(res_gp$X_eval, .name_repair = ~ c("x1","x2")) %>%
  mutate(method = "GP-BO")
evals_rand <- as_tibble(res_rand$X_eval, .name_repair = ~ c("x1","x2")) %>%
  mutate(method = "Random Search")

evals_all <- bind_rows(evals_bass, evals_gp, evals_rand)

ggplot(evals_all, aes(x = x1, y = x2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~method) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Sampled Locations in [0,1]^2",
    x = "x1", y = "x2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
